scope: small-graph exact conditional DBN development; no real-world superiority claim
target: terminal episode outcome given current prefix; equal total loss weight per episode
role_policy: only audited pre-run roles; absent roles remain unknown; do not infer roles from future actions
group_policy: optional explicit workflow.agent_to_node; no automatic grouping or label-informed clustering
inference: exact joint probabilities over workflow-node states and origin hypotheses; no independence closure at branches

source_adoption_transmission.scope: structure inspiration; not verified instruction adoption or independent-source recovery

authorization.scope: observed permission flags, not a full delegation or authorization verifier

global_head.scope: learned named observable and latent summaries; architectural choice, not a literature-proven mechanism

flat_feature_contract: 13 current-prefix observable summaries plus 49 chronological template counts; same raw information as joint BN, no latent learned states or labels; roles and capability manifests absent in this benchmark
comparison_scope: generic same-observation controls and architecture ablations, NOT reproductions of published MAS monitors
limitations: Exact cost grows exponentially with node groups plus origin hypotheses; fail above the declared limit.
Origin identity is only as reliable as logged source_id; missing IDs use entry-agent proxies.
Latent risks and role CPTs are not uniquely identifiable from episode labels.
Current benchmark has no explicit role/capability manifest or independent harm timestamp.
First observed origin class initializes its latent prior; later reclassification is not full Bayesian evidence revision.
One authorization injection per action; changed proposal/dispatch checks affect observables, not a revised old injection.
No state recovery or review-verifier semantics yet; latents persist within an episode.
Reused synthetic development data; not confirmatory results or an original MAS baseline reproduction.
